title: The Mark on the Wall
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：level　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 level 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There is a mark cut into the wall of the harbour at Portmadog, and for eleven years I have walked past it without asking what it was. Level, the harbourmaster wrote in 1904, is the only thing a wall can tell you. It is a ① level: the highest the water reached in 1904, cut by a harbourmaster who wanted the next man to know. Every ② level on that wall is a year somebody lost a boat.

The sea, of course, has its own opinion. Since 1998 the water has been ③ levelling up by about three millimetres a year, which sounds like nothing and is, at the scale of a century, everything; the level of the tide, the harbourmaster used to say, is the level of a town's luck, the sort of nothing that moves a town. My grandfather's generation talked about the weather; mine talks about the same subject at a different ④ level: measured instead of remembered.

What surprised me, when I finally read the harbour records, was how uneven the change is. At the ⑤ level of the harbour the water has risen eleven centimetres; two miles up the estuary it has risen less, because the land there is rising too. Averages are ⑥ levelled things, and a levelled thing tells you nothing about where to build a wall.

In 2013 the council commissioned a report. It set out eleven ⑦ levels of risk, each with a probability, and not one recommendation anybody was willing to sign. The engineer who read it for me, an old woman of eighty who had ⑧ levelled with me about the cost from the first meeting, said the level was never the difficulty, and neither was the water.

Every level, I have decided, is an argument about how long a town intends to stay. The wall was raised in 2019 by forty centimetres, ⑨ level along its whole length, which everybody agrees is not enough. I have a photograph of the mark now, taken at the ⑩ level of my own eye, on a calm day, at high tide. The water is four centimetres below the cut. In 1904 it was above it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 水位；水平高度（水、地面等的高度）
B. n. 水平；程度；层次（抽象）
D. adj. 平的；水平的（a level surface）
E. v. 使平整；使成水平；夷平（level sth）
F. v. 拉平；使一致（统计数据等）
G. 固定搭配：level with sb 对某人说实话；坦白相告
H. 固定搭配：at the level of 在……层面上／高度上

items.q: It is a level: the highest the water reached in 1904
Every level on that wall is a year somebody lost a boat
the water has been levelling up
the same subject at a different level
At the level of the harbour
It set out eleven levels of risk
who had levelled with me about the cost
taken at the level of my own eye

answers.why: 指刻在墙上的“水位”，即 1904 年水到达的最高处。
同样指水位刻线，说每一道刻线都是有人丢了船的一年。
level up 作动词，意为“（使）升到同一水平、逐步上升”，说海水每年上升约三毫米。
at a different level 意为“在不同的层面上”，说两代人谈的是同一件事，只是一个靠测量一个靠记忆。
at the level of 意为“在……的层面上、高度上”，此处指在海港这一段水面上。
level 作动词，意为“拉平、使一致”，说平均值是被抹平的东西。
levels of risk 意为“风险等级”，说报告列出十一个等级却没人愿意署名推荐。
level with sb 意为“对某人说实话、坦白相告”，说她一开始就如实相告。
level 作形容词，意为“平的、水平的”，说加高后的墙全长齐平。
at the level of one's eye 意为“与眼睛齐平的高度”。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 刻在墙上的是1904年的最高水位。（level）
自1998年以来，海水每年上升约三毫米。（level up）
在海港这一段，水位上升了十一厘米。（at the level of）
平均值是被抹平的东西。（level v.）
那份报告的详细程度令人印象深刻。（level of detail）
那位工程师从一开始就对我说实话。（level with）
answers: The level cut into the wall is the highest the water reached in 1904.
Since 1998 the water has been levelling up by about three millimetres a year.
At the level of the harbour the water has risen eleven centimetres.
The report's level of detail was impressive.
The engineer levelled with me about the cost from the first meeting.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 level 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The mark on the harbour wall is a level: the highest the water reached in 1904.
Since 1998 the water has been levelling up by about three millimetres a year.
At the level of the harbour it has risen eleven centimetres, and two miles up the estuary rather less.
Averages are levelled things, and a levelled thing tells you nothing about where to build a wall.
The report's level of detail was impressive, and its usefulness was not.
I photographed the mark at the level of my own eye, on a calm day, at high tide.
